cohort: The study included 371 HIV-positive mothers of infants in Eastern Ethiopian Hospitals.
finding: The magnitude of recommended infant feeding practice among HIV-positive mothers was 86%, with child age of 0-6 months, spontaneous vaginal delivery, and provision of expressed breast milk being significantly associated factors.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was significantly associated with recommended infant feeding practices, with mothers undergoing this mode of delivery being more likely to adhere to recommendations.
